Private Function Order(ws As Object, matching As Boolean) As String
    Dim r As Long, out As String
    ws.Range("A1:B400").Sort Key1:=ws.Range("A1"), Order1:=xlAscending, Header:=xlNo, MatchCase:=matching, Orientation:=xlTopToBottom
    For r = 1 To 400
        out = out & ws.Cells(r, 2).Value & ","
    Next
    Order = out
End Function

Public Function Measure() As String
    Dim wb As Object, ws As Object, out As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Columns("A").NumberFormat = "@"
    Fill ws
    out = Order(ws, False) & "|"
    ws.Cells.Clear
    ws.Columns("A").NumberFormat = "@"
    Fill ws
    out = out & Order(ws, True)
    wb.Close False
    Measure = out
End Function
